column1: # Registry of every temporal field (V1.9.38) -- read by TimeFieldClassificationTripwireTest.
# Format: qualifier<TAB>class<TAB>reason. One line per DTO property (dto:<DtoName>.<field>, scanned in lapis-shared) and per
# Exposed column (col:<TableObject>.<column>, scanned in lapis-server). Classes: A = server-stamped system timestamp, stored
# and sent as UTC, DISPLAYED in the organization zone. B = wall-clock typed in by a person (or derived from one) in the
# organization zone, NEVER converted for display, compared with ServerClock.nowIn(orgZone). D = calendar date (LocalDate).
# A trailing ? marks a doubtful case (still accepted, but listed in the review). LocalDate must be D, LocalTime must be B.
# A derived value inherits the class of its basis. See docs/architecture/time-and-timezones.adoc.
